descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-17 Post-Round Review & Completion · S13 Ask on Post-Round, Hospital: 'What tasks are still pending?' lists open tasks only

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T10 Ask from Post-Round (TFA-92593): 'Ask About the Encounter or Patient' opens from Post-Round in both contexts, and its answers use only this patient's stored data: the saved note as last edited, nothi … (TFA-92593 AC 2; TFA-92593 AC 3; TFA-92593 AC 6; TFA-92593 AC 9; UAT 3.4; UAT TC-17)
  • U14 AI check on scenarios, not single passes (3.2), if it applies to Post-Round Ask (Q8): the Ask set runs on at least 10 independent fixtures (5 Hospital, 5 Nursing Home), passes at 9/10 or better, and … (UAT 3.2)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Hospital patient with two open and two done tasks

When Ask the Post-Round preset 'What tasks are still pending?'

Then The answer names the BMP and the echo call, and no task that is not stored

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): mustInclude both open tasks; mustNotInclude tasks a model may add for CHF ('daily weight' also catches the done task 'Daily weight teaching' if it ever leaks into PENDING TASKS). buildAskContext sends only open tasks (!t.done), so 'neither done task' cannot be judged here and is no longer claimed. aiCheck group TC-17-ask

Where it ran: dev unit U47; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S13 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-17.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.
